function: Excluded, no_learning: downlink precoding by over-the-air Riemannian gradient descent optimized online on the current channel; model-based iterative algorithm, no trained model (p. 1, 4, 10).
notes: Excluded as no_learning (borderline, reviewer to confirm). The authors call DQNPM a Quasi-NN trained by over-the-air back-propagation, but it applies "We adopt the first-order Riemannian gradient descent method [26]" to the precoders (p. 4, Algorithm 1 on p. 5). It "differs from an ANN as it is model-based and optimized in real time" (p. 1) and "is a model-based approach and is fully-interpretable" (p. 10). No dataset, offline-trained model or generalization is involved; the weights are re-optimized when the channel changes (p. 8).
